echoParts: I have been crucified with Christ
verseText: I have been crucified with Christ, and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me.
meaning: When we believe in Jesus, we share in his death and life. His death on a cross was our death for our sins. And his new life on the third day means our forever life in his kingdom.

recall.question: Who does Paul say lives in him?

meaning.question: Paul says he was “crucified with Christ.” Crucified means put to death on a cross. What does Paul mean?
choices: Paul died on a cross too

application.prompt: When we believe in Jesus, He gives us a brand-new life! The next time you're tempted to do something wrong, remember that you don't have to keep living your old way. Jesus can help you choose what pleases Him!
